[[:File:Dreadnought's Drift non-interactive map.jpg|Non-interactive map]] | ingame name=Dreadnought's Drift | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=097 }} [[Dreadnought's Drift]] is the name given to the small, relatively open bottleneck between [[Lornar's Pass]] and [[Snake Dance]]. The area is densely populated with large groups of [[giant]]s and [[Stone Summit]], but the true terror of this area is [[Maw the Mountain Heart]], who makes its lair here along the eastern cliff faces. Although it seems an unlikely place, a [[statue]] of [[Dwayna]] can be found here, visible on the map as a pale ring along the southern cliff face. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] ([[Stone Summit]]) * {{w}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Carver]] * {{w}} 24 (26) [[Summit Giant Herder]] * {{r}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Ranger]] * {{mo}} 24 (26) [[Dolyak Master]] * {{me}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Heretic]] * {{n}} 24 (26) [[Stone Summit Gnasher]] [[Elemental]]s (Stone Summit) * {{e}} 24 (26) [[Siege Ice Golem]] [[Giant]]s * {{w}} 24 (26) [[Tundra Giant]] [[Griffon]]s * {{mo}} 24 (26) [[Blessed Griffon]] [[Nightmare]]s * {{mo}} 22 (26) [[Azure Shadow]] ====Bosses==== [[Wurm]]s (random spawn) * {{n}} 28 (30) [[Maw the Mountain Heart]] → [[Feast of Corruption]] ==Objects== [[Statue]]s * [[Statue of Dwayna]] ==Notes== *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.4% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 115|low = 111|high = 124}} **There are hidden [[Azure Shadow]]s in this area. **Beware the range and height advantage of the [[Tundra Giant]] groups in front of the Statue of Dwayna. **Consider bringing [[enchantment removal]] due to the possibility of as many as four [[Dolyak Master]]s spawning in the same group. **Due to how far this location is, consider vanquishing [[Snake Dance]], Dreadnought's Drift and [[Lornar's Pass]] in one go. Leaving from [[Camp Rankor]] to accomplish this will also allow for a party size of 8, where an exit from [[Beacon's Perch]] restricts the party to 6 members. ==Trivia== *Early in the days of Guild Wars, there used to be two chests in this area which required no key to open. The [[Lost Strongbox]], and the [[Frozen Chest]]. Out of each chest about 5-10 weapons and armor pieces would drop. This was a very well-kept secret but was eventually taken out for obvious reasons. {{Explorable areas in the Southern Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Schreckensdrift]]
